list_child.name: list_cleaning_visits
list_child.desc: Returns the complete list of cleaning visits currently on the schedule for this service. Use this whenever you need a full overview rather than a single visit's details.

get_child.name: get_cleaning_visit
get_child.desc: Returns the full record for one cleaning visit identified by its id. Call this once you already know which specific visit you need details on.

list_parent.name: list_clients
list_parent.desc: Returns every client account registered with this cleaning service. This is useful for browsing the client roster before drilling into a specific account.

get_parent.name: get_client
get_parent.desc: Returns the full record for one client account identified by its id. Use this when you need contact details or history for a specific client.

delete_child.name: delete_cleaning_visit
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a cleaning visit record from the schedule and cannot be undone once it runs. Only use this for visits that were entered in error or cancelled entirely.

set_enum.name: set_visit_state
set_enum.desc: Updates a cleaning visit's state to requested, confirmed, completed, or cancelled depending on where it stands. This should be called any time the visit's standing changes so the schedule stays accurate.

set_bool.name: flag_for_qa
set_bool.desc: Marks a cleaning visit as flagged for a quality assurance review by a supervisor. This is used whenever something about the visit warrants a closer look afterward.

set_ref.name: reassign_client
set_ref.desc: Reassigns a cleaning visit to a different client's account in the system. This is typically needed when a visit was originally logged under the wrong name.

send.name: email_client
send.desc: Sends an email notification to a client regarding one of their cleaning visits. This is the standard channel for routine updates that do not require a phone call.
